display_name: DURA 物理与正交残差解耦：Phase1 七景测试（源域 DURA 相对退化保护）
description: 冻结源训练模型后接相同 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 默认头，完整 clean 与六种 practical 预测后独立 truth-last，并与原 DURA 同 ID 配对。 使用源域 DURA 相对退化惩罚训练，训练选用 GPU。

data.representation: frozen candidate + frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on fixed Phase1 seven-view ground IQ
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Recovery training uses paired source IQ only; no F outputs, F weights, TX labels, V or target. Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after recovery checkpoint frozen.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Original DURA v1.0 stage2 E20/4940; zero-initialized new source-only orthogonal correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura verifies original7/63/30, training_F_access false, TX labels 0 and target_training false
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed DURA source-only original contract; no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent

rows.method: DURA plus signed innovation and orthogonal IQ correction, source-only DURA-relative degradation protection
rows.purpose: Complete mandatory Phase1 seven-view test and paired DURA comparison
rows.seed_notes: New model initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611, fixed input caches and DURA seed 2026092701; optimizer ordering 2026110613.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views

notes: One controller first runs real-checkpoint source smoke then source training; all predictions and independent scoring continue automatically.
No frozen-F weights or outputs enter source training; frozen F only read after model freeze for evaluation.
Source metrics never cancel any of the seven prespecified ground views.
Original DURA and previously user-stopped experiments are not changed.

Source loss: NMSE(output,clean) + .02 normalized change + .002 max(NMSE(output,clean)-NMSE(DURA,clean),0)/(NMSE(DURA,clean)+1e-4). Identical fit seed/IDs and epochs; CPU-vs-GPU differences prevent a strictly isolated loss comparison.
